title: Search Wikipedia and open an article
description: A public-website example: search Wikipedia for a topic and open its article. Uses a full web address in startUrl, so it ignores the sample app.
answersQuestions: How do I find an article on Wikipedia?

scenes.narration: Type a topic into the search box at the top of the page, then click Search.
The article opens with a short summary, followed by sections you can jump to from the contents list.
